mentions.note: the H. Parker Memorial Bowl is named after him
welcomed Arthur Whitehead to Belgrave in 1945

15th in 1913 South of Thames Junior race; later club official and President, President of the ECCU and Southern Counties CCA in the year he died; gave the 'Pyramid' Cup for shot put, remembered in the 'Parker Bowl'
in pre-World War I club group photograph
described as diminutive; early arrival at the new home
in Blackstaffe & Murphy Shield races group photo, 1914
